answer: What stops a thousand ballots on one stem? A saffron-stamp buys one ballot: five credentials from five families, re-checked against the beacon. Phone-number farms die by the vine check: a second stamp on the same line burns, stake slashed, key frozen. Gitcoin's Passport prices a human at a 20-point threshold; carrier lookups expose virtual numbers. Faking 10,000 ballots needs 10,000 real lines at $0.50–$2 each, 333 hours of live checks, and a $25 stake locked six epochs: over $250,000 at risk. Like saffron — 150,000 hand-picked flowers per kilogram — each ballot costs a real hand.
